selection: Start with four positive declared controls; greedy farthest-point selection over standardized exponent, reset fraction, coordinate standard deviations, covariance ratios, correlations and successive-step energy.
added_visual_filter: Exclude a256-state tail whose full-state maximum lag1..32return is below1e-10*(1+tail extent norm), even if preceding expansion windows are positive. Original scout outcomes remain unchanged.
camera: Rigid PCA followed by a fixed orthographic camera; equal spatial units. No nonlinear transform or separate axis scaling.
scope: Exploratory visual selection only; trajectories start at scout endpoints, not fresh basin samples.
